display.purpose: The home hero's claim only, held to 19ch; 92% width.

headline.purpose: Each page's h1, which is its claim and may carry live counts; 92% width.

title.purpose: Section h2s, with their count or date beside them on the baseline; 92% width.

subhead.purpose: h3, a frame's own title, the insider feed's day headings.

lede.purpose: The sentence under a page's claim, in Fog, at 64ch.

data.purpose: Table cells in tabular figures; ledger tables run 13px.

label.purpose: Notes, captions, counts and frame-head meta in Slate Label; column heads 12px.

ticker.purpose: Every ticker, Archivo semibold, stacked above the company name in Fog.

figure.purpose: Headline numbers in tabular figures: 15px proof values up to the 44px health score; 22px is the ledger total.

shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Floating layers only: the ticker search's suggestion list and the revenue chart's hover tip.

shadows.name: proof-lift
shadows.purpose: The home page's proof frames only: a soft offset shadow and a 1px highlight on the top edge.

shadows.name: inset-ring
shadows.purpose: An edge without a border (flag tiles, derived revenue bars, the fair-value band). Not elevation.

shadows.name: focus
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on every control; the one 2px line in the system.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one curve, expo-out, for every authored motion and the caret and arrow nudges.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Color, background and border changes on hover and press; row hover 120ms.

motion.name: unfold
motion.value: 420ms; clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) to inset(0 0 0 0), opacity 0.35 to 1
motion.purpose: The screener's opened row: its ledger unfolds top-down in place.

motion.name: arrive
motion.value: 500ms; clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0 round 8px) to inset(0 0 0 0 round 8px), opacity 0.4 to 1
motion.purpose: Insider companies added by Show more.

motion.name: travel
motion.value: 1.1s; marker left from var(--from); gap bar scaleX(0) to 1
motion.purpose: The report's price marker travels from the fair value's midpoint to today's price, drawing the gap.

motion.name: caret
motion.purpose: A row toggle's caret turns 90 degrees; a disclosure's caret 180 degrees.

motion.name: shimmer
motion.purpose: Loading skeletons, only without reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce everything is instant and content sits in its final place.

narrative.overview:
TFA reads like a ledger left open on the desk: one cool scale from navy-black to near-white, hairline seams, and figures in true tabular numerals. Every claim a page makes sits beside the live figure that proves it, and every score can be opened to show its working, part by part. The system exists to make numbers legible and checkable, then stay out of their way.

Density is high by default. Tables run at 13.5px with nine-pixel cell padding, and the ranked list starts above the fold. Explanation is kept one step away (a disclosure, an opened row, a hover tip) rather than removed. Hierarchy comes from two weights, steps of lightness on the neutral scale and 1px seams, never from hue. Color appears only when a figure has a direction: emerald when it is up or in the company's favor, a muted brick red when it is down or against it.

The world refuses the dark fintech dashboard: rounded cards on drop shadows, neon accents, glows and decorative charts. Its one signature is the 100-point score tape, ten segments each as wide as its part's maximum and filled to the points it earned. The brand mark is the same tape in miniature: two parts earned, one not.
keyCharacteristics: One cool neutral scale from Navy-Black (#090d14) to Cool Near-White (#e8ecf2); no accent hue.
Color is a sign: emerald for up or in favor, muted red for down or against, pale steel for a middle reading.
Archivo at two weights (400, 600) with tabular figures; h1 and h2 set at 92% width with negative tracking.
Flat frames: a 1px hairline border, an 8px corner, no shadow.
The primary button is the scale's lightest step, inverted, not a hue.
The score tape and its ledger are the signature components.
One authored motion per page on an expo-out curve, always gated by reduced motion.

rules.name: The Sign-Only Rule
rules.body: Emerald and red state direction and nothing else: a figure's sign, or a word that is itself a reading for or against the company. Flags, category tags (tier, source), the score tape and every structural element stay on the neutral scale, the icon or the word carrying the meaning.

rules.name: The No Third Hue Rule
rules.body: A middle reading is Pale Steel (#c3ccda), never amber, yellow or blue. Amber was retired from this system because a third hue turns "fair" into a warning.

rules.name: The Inverse Primary Rule
rules.body: The primary action is Inverse Near-White with Navy-Black text. There is no brand hue to put on a button, a link or a focus ring; focus is a 2px Cool Near-White outline.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: 400 and 600 only. Emphasis inside a sentence is 600 in Cool Near-White; anything more comes from size, width and the neutral scale.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every figure uses tabular numerals and is right-aligned in its column, its column name aligned with it. A number that does not line up digit by digit is a defect.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings, labels, tags and buttons are sentence case. Nothing is set in uppercase or tracked caps, and no label sits above a heading.

rules.name: The Claim Beside Proof Rule
rules.body: A page or section opens with one short claim and, beside it, the live figures that make it true: a row of counts, a top-five frame, a ledger. A claim with no figure next to it does not ship.

rules.name: The No Page Scroll Rule
rules.body: Nothing scrolls the page sideways at any width. Wide tables scroll inside their frame with sticky leading columns, or reflow into labelled blocks.

rules.name: The Flat Frame Rule
rules.body: A frame is Frame Slate, a Hairline Seam border and an 8px corner, with no shadow. Shadow belongs to what floats (popovers, tooltips) and to the home page's proof frames; nowhere else.

rules.name: The One Painted Ground Rule
rules.body: The only painted background is the home hero's faint radial lift of Pale Steel at 7% behind the proof. Every other gradient is functional: the fade at a scrolling edge and the loading shimmer.

rules.name: The Tape Rule
rules.body: A score is always a numeral plus its tape, and the tape always shows every part; it is never a colored badge, a ring or a green-to-red bar.

rules.name: The One Motion Rule
rules.body: Each page has one authored motion, on the expo-out curve `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, and content is fully visible without it. The screener's opened ledger unfolds top-down by clip-path over 420ms; insider companies added by "Show more" arrive the same way over 500ms; on the report the price marker travels from the fair value's midpoint to today's price over 1.1s while the gap between them draws. Everything else is a 150ms color change. Under reduced motion every transition is instant and no animation runs.

dos: Do put the figure that proves a claim beside it: a row of live counts by the h1, a top-five frame by the home hero, a ledger by "why it ranks first".
Do keep color to direction: Sign Emerald (#3fbf8c) for up or in favor, Sign Red (#e2706a) for down or against, each on a 12% tint of itself when it is a tag.
Do set every figure in tabular numerals, right-aligned, and every ticker in Archivo 600 at +0.01em over the company name in Fog.
Do separate with 1px seams (#1c2433) and group with one frame (Frame Slate, 8px corner) rather than with shadows or extra containers.
Do step interaction states up the neutral scale: Hover Slate, then Current Slate, then Pressed Slate.
Do tell flags apart by icon on neutral tiles, with a legend and screen-reader names.
Do reflow tables into labelled blocks on phones and keep the page free of sideways scroll.
Do draw icons from the sprite (24px grid, 1.75px round strokes, currentColor, 1.15em).
donts: Don't build the dark fintech dashboard this world refuses: rounded cards on drop shadows, neon accents, glows or decorative charts.
Don't add a third hue, including amber or yellow for a middle reading; it is Pale Steel (#c3ccda).
Don't color the score, a flag tile or a category tag by its value; the tape fills in Pale Steel and only the warning flag's icon is red.
Don't put a shadow on a frame other than the home page's proof frames, and don't nest a frame inside a frame.
Don't use weights other than 400 and 600, a monospace for tickers, or uppercase and tracked caps anywhere.
Don't paint backgrounds beyond the home hero's single 7% radial lift.
Don't add motion beyond each page's one authored moment, or animate anything that hides content until it plays.
